title: Pure Rescue-ACE
summary: Rescue-ACE cards with generic staples. Rescue-ACE Hydrant is the engine: while it is out, Rescue-ACE Quick-Plays and Traps Set by your Rescue-ACE effects can be used the turn they're Set, and ALERT! and RESCUE! upgrade. Air Lifter, Monitor and Impulse search or tag in another Rescue-ACE when the opponent uses a monster effect, and Turbulence Sets four Spells/Traps from the Deck. The Burst Protocol cards lead: Quick Attacker Tributes itself to search any Rescue-ACE monster, and Arbitrator fetches Hydrant or HQ and destroys a card each time you use a Rescue-ACE Quick-Play or Trap.
main: Rescue-ACE Quick Attacker
2026 support. Shuffles a Rescue-ACE back to summon itself; Tributes itself to search a Rescue-ACE monster.
Rescue-ACE Air Lifter
Summoned: searches a Rescue-ACE Spell; tags in another Rescue-ACE on their monster effect.
Rescue-ACE Hydrant
Untouchable next to another Rescue-ACE; your Set Rescue-ACE cards are live at once.
Rescue-ACE Impulse
Shuts off their strongest monster; tags in a Machine Rescue-ACE from the Deck.
Rescue-ACE Monitor
Summoned: searches a Rescue-ACE Trap; revives a Rescue-ACE on their monster effect.
Rescue-ACE Fire Engine
Joins when a Rescue-ACE arrives; summons a Level 4 Rescue-ACE when they summon.
Rescue-ACE Fire Attacker
Joins when a Rescue-ACE arrives; draws when they add cards.
Rescue-ACE Turbulence
Level 9: Sets four Rescue-ACE Quick-Plays and Traps from the Deck.
Rescue-ACE Preventer
Level 8: flips a monster face-down on either turn.
ALERT!
Returns a Rescue-ACE monster, or searches one with Hydrant out.
EMERGENCY!
Summons a Rescue-ACE from the Deck; from the GY, Sets a Rescue-ACE Trap.
RESCUE!
Revives a Rescue-ACE, or their monster with Hydrant out.
Rescue-ACE HQ
Field Spell: an extra Rescue-ACE Normal Summon and a recycle-draw.
EXTINGUISH!
Destroys a monster and locks its name with Hydrant out.
CONTAIN!
Negates a monster and blocks it as material with Hydrant out.
REINFORCE!
Protects a Rescue-ACE; from the GY, Sets a Rescue-ACE Spell.
extra: 2026 support. Link-4 for FIREs: fetches Hydrant or HQ and destroys a card per Rescue-ACE Quick-Play or Trap.
